name: web-dev-repo
description: Git hooks for this repository: lint staged files and check commit messages.

scripts.lint: shellcheck tools/*.sh web-dev/skills/*/scripts/*.sh web-dev/scripts/*.sh web-dev/evals/*.sh web-dev/evals/fixtures/*.sh web-dev/evals/*/setup.sh && for f in tools/*.mjs web-dev/scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
